raw_structured_proposal.summary:
Diagnosis: slug() only trimmed and uppercased input, yielding 'NEW 2' instead of expected 'new-2'. It needed to lowercase and replace internal whitespace with hyphens (collapsing multiple spaces).
Fix: Updated slug.py to return "-".join(x.strip().lower().split()). This trims, lowercases, splits on any whitespace, and joins with hyphens.
Test: Ran pytest; all tests passed (1 passed).
